note: Appended daily by a scheduled agent. Newest first. Each item was checked on the date shown.

items.name: Teach For India Fellowship 2027
items.what: Closes 1 Nov 2026, 11:59pm IST. Paid two-year full-time teaching fellowship in government and low-fee schools across nine Indian cities (Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune); ₹30,000/month stipend plus a city allowance of ₹6,000–12,600 and health insurance up to ₹1,00,000. Open to Indian citizens or OCI holders who will complete graduation by June/July 2027 — no prior teaching experience required. Runs entirely in India, so it sidesteps US work authorisation altogether.

items.name: WorldQuant BRAIN Consultant Program
items.what: Rolling, no deadline, free to join. Learn quantitative signal-building ('alphas') for free on WorldQuant's BRAIN simulation platform; hit 10,000 points and gold status and you're invited into the paid Consultant Program, with quarterly payouts the site reports as $2,000+ at Master level and $8,000+ at Grandmaster level. Fully remote, open to residents of 17 listed countries including India and the US, no degree required, must be 18 or older.

items.name: AAAI-27 Student Scholar Volunteer Program
items.what: Application window 30 Nov – 4 Dec 2026 for partial travel support plus complimentary registration to volunteer at AAAI-27 (16–23 Feb 2027, Montréal, Canada), one of the top AI research conferences. Eligibility catch: you must be a full-time student and AAAI member with a paper submitted to the conference and a faculty recommendation letter — not open to non-students or anyone without a submitted paper.

items.name: Chevening Scholarships — 2027/2028 cycle
items.what: Closes 6 Oct 2026 at 11:00 UTC (4:30pm IST) — nine days away. Free to apply. Fully funded one-year UK master's for Indian citizens covering tuition, a monthly stipend and flights, with studies starting Sep/Oct 2027. Requires an undergraduate degree plus at least two years of post-degree work experience (2,800 hours), and a commitment to return to India for two years after the award ends. Chevening's residency rules are written around applying from your home country or another ODA-eligible country, so confirm with the India office before applying from the USA.

items.name: ARC Prize 2026
items.what: Submissions due 2 Nov 2026, papers due 8 Nov 2026, results announced 4 Dec 2026. $2M prize pool across three tracks (ARC-AGI-2, ARC-AGI-3 and a paper prize), run through Kaggle with no fee, no degree and no affiliation required, so open worldwide subject to Kaggle's own country rules. Winning entries must be open-sourced under a permissive licence, and no internet or API-based models (GPT, Claude and the like) are allowed during evaluation.

items.name: Techstars Anywhere Accelerator — 2027 cohort
items.what: Final deadline 18 Nov 2026; programme runs 8 Mar to 3 Jun 2027 with Demo Day on 3 Jun. Remote-first, so no relocation, though there are three in-person offsites and it is aimed at companies operating in American time zones. Free to apply and Techstars invests on acceptance, but the page does not state the amount or equity — dates unconfirmed on terms, so check those before applying. No founder-nationality restriction is stated.

items.name: MLDS 2027
items.what: Bengaluru 25–26 Feb 2027 and Hyderabad 4–5 Mar 2027. India's flagship applied AI and agentic-systems conference for developers, run by Analytics India Magazine, expecting 3,000+ practitioners and 100+ speakers. Paid and open to anyone with no free pass advertised: standard pass INR 6,000 on super early bird against INR 7,800 regular, and the super early bird ends 13 Nov 2026. Student and group passes exist.

items.name: MATS Residency — Winter 2027 intake
items.what: Closes 31 Oct 2026 AoE, currently open. A salaried 6–24 month AI safety research role paying $155,000–$285,000/yr gross, plus up to $25,000 relocation, insurance and uncapped compute. Explicitly no PhD, no publication record and no prior AI safety background required; open worldwide with visa support. Hybrid out of London, Berkeley or Washington DC, at least one-third in person. Next window after this one opens March 2027.

items.name: NeurIPS 2026 — Financial Assistance
items.what: Closes 6 Oct 2026, 23:59 AoE. Main conference is 6–12 Dec 2026 in Sydney, with Atlanta and Paris satellites. You do NOT need an accepted paper or student status — any career stage may apply on financial need, first-time attendance or accessibility grounds. Covers free registration (in-person or virtual) plus up to 7 nights of prepaid hotel; flights, meals and local transport are NOT covered.

items.name: Entrepreneur First — Winter 27 Bangalore
items.what: Early deadline 5 Oct 2026 for the first selection round; cohort starts Feb 2027, full-time and in person in Bangalore. Pays an INR 360,000 talent investment during the 12-week co-founder matching phase, then S$75,000 pre-seed for 10% if the investment committee backs your company. Free to apply, no nationality bar — this is the India-route accelerator, so US work authorisation is not a factor.

items.name: St. Gallen Symposium — Global Ideas Competition 2027
items.what: Submit by 1 Feb 2027, 23:59 UTC-12. Free to enter, no nationality restrictions, but you must be enrolled at master's level or higher at a research university and born in 1997 or later. Top 100 get fully funded travel, accommodation and meals to the 56th Symposium in Switzerland; three awardees share a CHF 20,000 prize fund. Entry is a 1,000-word solution brief plus a 3-minute video.

items.name: Mercor — AI training and evaluation contracts
items.what: Rolling applications, no deadline and no fee to join. Marketplace pairing domain experts with AI labs for model training and evaluation work; the site advertises an average contracted rate of $109/hr and roles at $90–$150/hr. Country eligibility is set per role and is not stated site-wide — dates unconfirmed, verify eligibility on the specific listing before counting on it.

items.name: IAPS AI Policy Fellowship — Spring 2027
items.what: Closes 27 Sep 2026. Fully funded, $18K fellows / $24K senior, global applications, two weeks in DC.

items.name: Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026
items.what: 17–19 Nov 2026 at BIEC. Asia's largest tech summit; the key India networking event this year.

items.name: Citadel Conference Travel Grant
items.what: Fully covers registration, flights, hotel and food for NeurIPS, ICML and Grace Hopper. Requires current enrolment.
